brief:
President Isaac Herzog faces pressure to navigate a fractured political landscape as Israel struggles to assemble a governing coalition, Al Jazeera English reported. Eisenkot's bloc and Arab-led parties are maneuvering to unseat Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but their efforts remain uncertain. The political deadlock could ultimately preserve Netanyahu's hold on power if coalition talks collapse.

The outcome hinges on Herzog's handling of the mandate-allocation process and which parties can bridge their differences. Coalition-building has proven elusive despite multiple rounds of negotiations among potential partners opposed to Netanyahu's continued leadership.
dek: Eisenkot's bloc and Arab-led parties seek to oust Netanyahu, but failure to form government could leave him in power.
title: Herzog confronts government-formation impasse as Netanyahu rivals scramble
